# Federico Bello (Fede Bello)

> Federico Bello (also "Fede Bello", Federico Bello Pérez) is a Uruguayan Machine Learning Engineer. He is currently a student of the MVA master (Mathématiques, Vision, Apprentissage) at ENS Paris-Saclay in Paris, as a Sophie Germain Scholar. Previously Lead Machine Learning Engineer at Tryolabs, working as a Forward Deployed Engineer with the LlamaIndex team on enterprise AI document processing. Degree in Telecommunications Systems Engineering from UdelaR (Uruguay), with an award-winning thesis on anomaly detection with Graph Neural Networks. Languages: Spanish, English, German, French.

Ingeniero de Machine Learning uruguayo, máster MVA en la ENS Paris-Saclay. / Ingénieur Machine Learning uruguayen, master MVA à l'ENS Paris-Saclay.
